title: Animate extracted initial sprite frames
changes: Play, loop and stop extracted initial-pose frame sequences at a user-selected preview rate using stored durations.
Use a shared origin and bounding box across frames so differing object offsets remain visible; reject empty or invalid frame sequences.
validation: Synthetic Linux Chrome unit rom-data-viewer-spriteanim-58wsec92 checked frame alignment, reference pixels, durations, loop, stop, invalid rates and section closure.
Protected EUR unit rom-data-viewer-spriteanim-eur-4ekn367f compared 121 bindings and 477 frame durations with the extraction and checked independent bounds, pixel and animation in Chrome.
limitations: Zero duration uses one preview tick; the chosen preview rate is not game timing. Unsupported object modes and live palette changes remain outside the preview.
